sources.quote: HD 100655, also named Formosa, is a star in the zodiac constellation of Leo, located 451 light-years away from the Sun.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 45 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,803 K, so 9.726 solar radii.
